command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
cd /tmp
# This task exists to serve the bowtie2 and minimap2 METHOD comparisons, not to benchmark bwa:
# both need a bwa alignment of the same small chr20 fixture to compare placements against. It is
# a declared output of this recipe so the chain is statically checkable -- the previous
# arrangement had them reading this recipe's main output, which silently broke the moment that
# moved to the whole genome and became aln.sam.gz.
echo '== bwa baseline on the chr20 smoke fixture (400k pairs) for cross-tool comparisons =='
bwa index chr20.fa 2> bwaidx.log
bwa mem -t 4 -R '@RG\tID:smoke\tSM:HG00096\tPL:ILLUMINA' chr20.fa \
    HG00096_chr20smoke_1.fq.gz HG00096_chr20smoke_2.fq.gz > aln_chr20smoke.sam 2> bwa.log
PRIM=$(awk '!/^@/{f=$2; if (int(f/256)%2==0 && int(f/2048)%2==0) n++} END{print n+0}' aln_chr20smoke.sam)
MAPPED=$(awk '!/^@/{f=$2; if (int(f/256)%2==0 && int(f/2048)%2==0 && int(f/4)%2==0) n++} END{print n+0}' aln_chr20smoke.sam)
{
  echo "purpose          baseline for bowtie2 / minimap2 method comparisons, not a benchmark"
  echo "primary_records  $PRIM  want 800000 (400k pairs, one primary each)"
  echo "mapped_primary   $MAPPED"
} > baseline-check.txt
cat baseline-check.txt
test "$PRIM" -eq 800000
echo 'BASELINE OK'
